summary.text: Tehmi Chassion is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 44 (Lafayette Parish), and was elected in 2023, according to the official House member page.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Tehmi Chassion's occupation as Pharmacist, Roofing & Construction and Real Estate Agent.
It lists education as B.S., Microbiology, Louisiana State University; Pharm.D., Xavier University of Louisiana.

The page lists committee assignments including Health and Welfare, Labor and Industrial Relations, and Transportation, Highways and Public Works, and caucus affiliations including the Acadiana Delegation, the Democratic Caucus and the Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus.
